items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: starting out with Little Richard, or whoever it was he...Muddy Waters and all them. Where did he get that money?

ctx.x: No. It would be a logical thing to do. It seems hard to get musicians to organize to work together on something like that.

Or when the guys get ready to take their songs, it isn't the musicians that do it, either. It's the guy .. why don't these culprits.......I call them culprits because they're not fair. Why don't they take a song and say, "Hey, I made a million dollars. That's too much money for me to make. I'm going to go out here and see if this guy's got some food tonight." And I don't want them to tell me they don't make a million dollars out of a song. If they do, somebody's lying, 'cause then the government's stupid, because…

So I'm hoping, if you'd like to, sometime in the near future, I may ask you to, when these things are in the archives, that you may include my book as a supplement to them. It's on the house. I'm making you a gratis offer. And included with that would be the pictures that are going to be in my book. And possibly an appeal to the black musician to wake up. What do you think?
